usedFor: Shopify holds orders and products, and FreeAgent receives records through “Create Contact” and “Create Task”.

bestTemplate.name: “Order Paid” in Shopify, then “Create Contact” in FreeAgent
bestTemplate.why: A paid order is a real customer, so FreeAgent gets a contact for the accounts.

watchOut: “Order Line Items Are Edited” runs on edits too, so “Create Contact” can run twice for the same order.
